concepts.def: Processes instructions via the fetch–decode–execute cycle.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Components Of A Computer — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Components Of A Computer brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Components Of A Computer.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Operating system”?
options: Small fast SRAM between CPU and RAM; L1, L2, L3 levels; exploits temporal/spatial locality.
Stored-program computer with CPU, memory, I/O; control and data share bus (Von Neumann 1945 EDVAC report).
Manages CPU scheduling, memory, file systems, I/O, security; UNIX 1969 (Thompson & Ritchie).
Base-2 numerals; integers as two's complement; characters via ASCII (1963) or Unicode UTF-8.
